source.title: React sourcing homepage and complete workspace visual redesign
source.body:
Replace ProcureFlow's basic presentation with a React-owned public sourcing homepage/application shell and consistent full-workspace visual system, preserving accepted identity/marketplace/procurement flows through a stable isolated feature-controller host.

REQ-UI-001..003@R1 / BL-UI-R1, VER-UI-REQ-002 I1 PASS, GATE-UI-R1-DELEGATED. Frozen combined requirement/decisions/test plan: .agile-v/requirements/baselines/ui-react-r1/requirement.md, SHA256 2cfa5db2919e46dfb01784544724b686eb9827c7c2159e146b72ac097e7041eb. Distinct implementation gate follows issue creation.

Owner asks Fast Sourcing Brothers visual hierarchy with #171721 #872B97 #FF7130 #FF3C68, confirms homepage plus full workspace, requests four project-local design/testing skills and VoltAgent design reference collection. Preserve same-origin session/CSRF/server authorization, escaping, permission/status checks, all current flows and applied migrations. No new API/entity/FK or backend business behavior. No paid tools or implicit publication/deployment.

Scope: React/ReactDOM + Vite build, self-hosted font, responsive landing/header/nav/auth/workspace styles, explicit stable lifetime feature adapter and latest-shell-navigation request settling, Docker Node build stage/static assets, pinned skill provenance/licenses, exact traceability and study notes. TC-UI-001..005: clean build/real local preview, desktop/tablet/mobile screenshots/contrast/keyboard/reduced-motion/no overflow, auth/query/marketplace/backforward/race handling, real isolated DB/SMTP procurement-through-receipt plus employee invitations/grants/deactivation and supplier publishing visibility, actual Docker build/secret exclusion, separate implementation review/final acceptance. Never claim a full JSX migration of retained imperative forms.
